title: Scan Run Gate Count
statement: Let $x$ be a bit string, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $C$ be an algebraic circuit on $n$ variables. If decoding $x$ yields exactly the pair $(n,C)$ and $C$ is well formed, then the index component of the scan run on $x$ is the all-ones bit string of length equal to the number of gates of $C$.
